title: Separate supply.
officialText:
A separate tap and service shall be installed for each building fronting on a street in which there is a city
(street) water main, and no consumer will be allowed to supply water to other persons or premises, except in a project where more
than one building under a single ownership is supplied from a common house tank or booster system located in or on one of the
buildings.
